description.en-US: Apps by Simon Pena, signed with the author's key: the same APKs as each app's GitHub Releases. Source, and how to check a release, are linked from each app.

summary.en-US: Read your voice messages, transcribed on your phone

description.en-US:
Share a voice message from WhatsApp, Telegram or any app to Unmuffle, and
it transcribes it on your phone with whisper.cpp. Words appear as they are
transcribed, under a player for the audio; words Whisper is unsure of are
marked. Copy or share the transcript, or transcribe it again in another
language.

Audio and transcripts stay on the phone. The only permission is Internet,
used once to download the Whisper model (MIT licensed) from Hugging Face
and check it; you can also pick a model file instead.

Written with AI: Claude Code writes the code, under the author's
direction, and it is tested on the author's phones. Each release can be rebuilt from its tag and
compared: see the source.
